webhooks.summary: The Discord HTTP API (Preview) OpenAPI content does not define any inbound event-delivery webhooks. There are no `webhookEventNames`, no `webhookDefinitionsSample`, and no `operationCallbacks`. The operations under `webhookManagementOperations` describe Discord's own webhook resources — URLs that external systems POST to in order to deliver messages into Discord channels (e.g., `execute_webhook`, `execute_github_compatible_webhook`, `execute_slack_compatible_webhook`, plus CRUD on webhooks/messages). These are receiver/destination webhooks for Discord, not subscriptions that fire events to a user-supplied HTTPS endpoint. Discord delivers real-time events over its Gateway (WebSocket), not via HTTP webhook subscriptions, and that is not represented here.

managementEndpoints.description: List webhooks for a channel (Discord-side webhook resources, not event subscriptions).
Create a Discord channel webhook (a URL used to POST messages into the channel).
List webhooks for a guild (Discord-side webhook resources).
Execute a webhook (POST a message into Discord).
Execute a GitHub-compatible webhook (Discord receives GitHub payload).
Execute a Slack-compatible webhook (Discord receives Slack payload).

signature.detail: No inbound webhook signature scheme is defined in the provided OpenAPI content. Discord's documented webhook operations are outbound/destination execution endpoints, not event subscriptions requiring payload verification.
